brand.name: Dos Amigos (1987)
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full 112-brand index. Confirmed as a genuinely separate, distinct brand from the site's unrelated existing listing 'Dos Hermanos' and from Drew Estate's 'ACID Amigos' line - not a misremembering of either. A brand-new (2025) brand conceived in Barcelona, Spain by founders Jordi Llorens(-Carrio) and Isidre Pineda, with cigars produced in Nicaragua. The '1987'/'87' in the full brand name reportedly references the founders' birth year (per Cigar Journal). Officially launched internationally at InterTabac 2025 (Germany); German retail distribution handled by importer Feine Puros & Zubehor (Garmisch-Partenkirchen). Covered so far mainly by European trade press (Cigar Journal, Cigar Smoker Club) rather than US cigar media, consistent with its absence from this site's index.
brand.founded_note: Brand launched internationally at InterTabac 2025; a specific company-founding year was not stated in any source found.
brand.origin_country: Nicaragua (manufacture); project conceived in Barcelona, Spain

line.name: Dos Amigos 1987
line.description: Launched deliberately as a focused two-vitola portfolio (not a 3-vitola lineup). Each vitola also carries its own marketing nickname: the Robusto is called 'Paster' and the Toro is called 'Sidecar.' Tobacco aged a minimum of 2 years; profile described as mild, with sweetness and a touch of spice. FLAG: a reported factory name ('Cociagsa/CIGOI,' Nicaragua) comes from a single source and could not be independently corroborated - recorded with that caveat rather than asserted as settled.
line.factory: Reported as 'Cociagsa (CIGOI),' Nicaragua - single-sourced, not independently corroborated.

research_notes: A 3rd Mac photo, 'DosAmigos_Churchill_01.jpg', implies a Churchill vitola - NO source found documents a Churchill for this brand. Every source consistently describes the catalog as exactly the 2 vitolas above. NOT added as a confirmed vitola - see _dos-amigos-churchill-UNRESOLVED.json. A 3rd, market-specific release ('Zwoa Spezln,' a Bavarian/Munich-themed German/Austrian exclusive, Pigtail vitola 5.5x54) also exists but has no matching Mac photo and is a different, region-exclusive SKU, not added here. 2 generic 'Product_Box-Open' Mac photos could not be attributed to either specific vitola without viewing the images directly.
